indications.name: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in adults and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older who are currently receiving a survival motor neuron 2 (SMN2)-targeted treatment

pivotal.indication: Spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in adults and pediatric patients 2 years of age and older who are currently receiving a survival motor neuron 2 (SMN2)-targeted treatment
pivotal.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-10-30: Confirmed by label section 14 and the registry record.

evidence.quote: The efficacy of ISEMBYLD for the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) in patients 2 years of age and older was demonstrated in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter clinical trial (Study 1; NCT05156320).
